description: Use when you need company financials from SEC filings, earnings or fundamentals of a US company by ticker for the last two years. Do not use for quarterly numbers, real-time prices, non-US companies or filings older than two years. Returns JSON with SEC company financials for a US stock ticker from 10-K filings on SEC EDGAR: annual revenue, net and operating income, diluted EPS, cash flow and the balance sheet for 0.02 USDC per call. Typical response time 300 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.02 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

ticker.description: Stock ticker of a company that files with the SEC, e.g. AAPL

name: blackwood_sec_facts
title: SEC company financials
